dedupeText: mid century soul album cover aesthetic 1960s soul monochromatic silhouettes bold sans serif textured paper primary color palette dancing figures vertical alignment between text blocks and the figures below rhythmic repetition of color blue green red purple across both text and imagery contrast between the flat bold typography and the soft textured edges of the silhouettes combine heavy condensed sans serif thin black outline with monochromatic watercolor silhouettes on aged cream paper using a rhythmic 4 color palette

recipe.visualDefinition: A 1960s-inspired graphic composition featuring four stylized, monochromatic watercolor-wash silhouettes of dancing figures in a row, topped by two lines of heavy, condensed sans-serif display type with thin black outlines and alternating solid color fills.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical alignment between text blocks and the figures below
Rhythmic repetition of color (Blue, Green, Red, Purple) across both text and imagery
Contrast between the flat, bold typography and the soft, textured edges of the silhouettes
coreInvariants: Thin black stroke outlining all letterforms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, arranged horizontally in dynamic poses.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top two lines of large-scale text act as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down reading order, followed by a left-to-right scan of the rhythmic dancing figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous breathing room around the figures and between the text and the top edge.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red, Blue, Green, and Purple (Subject fills)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation colors against a low-value, warm-toned neutral background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' features a high horizontal crossbar
The 'S' is tightly coiled and vertical
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family variation using color to distinguish lines.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature
Captures the mid-century display aesthetic perfectly

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vintage 1960s album cover background on aged cream paper. In the lower two-thirds, place four monochromatic watercolor silhouettes of people dancing (one blue, one green, one red, one purple) in a horizontal row. Leave the top third empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, extra-condensed bold sans-serif text in all caps. Apply a thin black outline to all letters. Fill the letters with alternating solid colors matching the figures below (Red, Purple, Blue, Green).

verificationChecks: Is the paper texture visible and aged?
Do the silhouettes have a watercolor-wash texture?
Is the text extra-condensed with a thin black stroke?
Are the colors vibrant and primary-focused?

mustRedesign: Artist name and album title text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern digital artifacts are present.
Check that the watercolor bleed doesn't obscure the figure shapes.
Verify the text outline is consistent across all characters.
Confirm the cream background has a tactile, fibrous quality.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Heavy Condensed Sans-Serif + Thin Black Outline] with [Monochromatic Watercolor Silhouettes] on [Aged Cream Paper] using a [Rhythmic 4-Color Palette].
